procs.name: Umbral Glaive
procs.tooltip:
|cFF66DDFFLevel 30 Passive|r
Ranged attacks now have a $h% chance to transform |cffffffffHex of Malice|r into |cffffffffUmbral Glaive|r for $504588d.@s:501134:0@

Chance increased by your ranged critical strike rating.
procs.proc_spell_source: AscensionWitchDoctorEvents.cpp:157-158 (Proc case UmbralTalent: buff(UmbralReady) is Cast(owner, owner, 504588)); 504588 Umbral Glaive, DurationIndex 1 = 10000 ms, the tooltip token $504588d
procs.handler: aura_ascension_witch_doctor_event (spell_script_names row of 681242, rev_20260909_00_witch_doctor_completion.sql:174-175): Check case UmbralTalent (AscensionWitchDoctorEvents.cpp:91-96) accepts an outgoing damage hit that is not Umbral Glaive 501134 itself and whose proc type mask holds PROC_FLAG_DONE_RANGED_AUTO_ATTACK or PROC_FLAG_DONE_SPELL_RANGED_DMG_CLASS, and rolls roll_chance_f(ProcChance 10 + player->GetRatingBonusValue(CR_CRIT_RANGED)) once; the engine roll is neutralised (spell_proc Chance 100 since rev_20261003_10_coa_script_rolled_proc_chance.sql, which fixed the P x P double roll of #4275 that made 10% into 1%), so the script roll is the only one. The reference character has no ranged critical strike rating (the class file ratings hold the three hit ratings only), so the chance is the 10% of the DBC. Trigger: Reclamation 806288 (DmgClass 3 ranged, SpellFamilyFlags[1] bit 4, RangeIndex 113, 8% of the base mana, CastingTimeIndex 23 = 1800 ms, StartRecoveryTime 1500, needs the bow 2000265 the harness equips through armed_for) at the dummy 15 yd away (a ranged cast at the melee default distance is refused as TOO_CLOSE, Spell.cpp:7352-7357; RangeIndex 113 is 0 to 30 yd; the missile of Speed 35 lands about 430 ms after the 1800 ms cast, inside the 2300 ms attempt spacing; the reference character carries ranged_hit_rating 10000). Each landed Reclamation is one trial: it grants a Spirit but Umbral Glaive does not read Spirit. The baseline phase (the passive unknown) casts the trigger and must read no ready buff cast. Residual failure probability (estimate, normal approximation, the tool states its own figure in the verdict row): the band is 2 points (the larger of 5% of 10 and 2); residual_target 0.001 judges the pooled Wilson interval at confidence 0.9995 (z 3.48), whose half-width at 16470 attempts (one trial each, 90 parts of 183) is 0.81 points, so band + 2 x half-width = 3.63 points, under min_detectable 4; a true rate of a server 4 points off (14% or 6%) is rejected with probability above 0.99999, and a correct 10% server is falsely alerted with probability at most 0.001 per pair. The attempts are 2300 ms of game time each, 10.5 h per run, 90 parts of about 7 game minutes; accelerated, the Witch Hunter proofs of this size took minutes of wall time.

procs.handler: AscensionWitchDoctorEvents.cpp:98-99 (Check, case Overflow): damage and the spell is Shadow Puppet 802745 (PuppetHit, the hit each Shadow Puppets 500015 tick casts, Auras.cpp:279-283) or Puppeteer's Threads damage 572837 (ThreadsDamage); :73 lets a derived spell through for Overflow; :164-167 (Proc): Reduce(player, BadJuju, INT32_MAX) (Completion.cpp:161-174: RemoveSpellCooldown of every known rank with update) and Cast(OverflowBuff 705845). 705844 is a passive with ProcFlags 0 and ProcChance 15 ($h) and a spell_proc row (ProcFlags 332116, AttributesMask 2, Chance 0 after rev_20260919_20, so the DBC 15 applies); the aura script aura_ascension_witch_doctor_event (rev_20260909_00 :183) filters in DoCheckProc. 705845 (DurationIndex 1 = 10000 ms) Effect[0] SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_RESET_COOLDOWN of Bad Juju 802087 (MiscValueB 1: its category too) and Effect[1] aura 107 SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN -10000 on Bad Juju (mask word 1 1024), consumed by the next Juju cast (Abilities.cpp:376, consume(OverflowBuff, IsJuju)). Shadow Puppets 500015: instant, GCD 1500, 15% base mana, RecoveryTime 18000 reset before each cast, DurationIndex 27 = 3000 ms, EffectAmplitude 750 with SPELL_ATTR5_EXTRA_INITIAL_PERIOD, so 5 PuppetHit events per cast. internal_cooldown_ms 3250 is the attempt spacing, not a spell_proc cooldown (the row's Cooldown is 0): the attempts are 3750 ms apart so a cast's 3000 ms aura (extra initial tick plus four ticks of 750 ms) ends before the next cast refreshes it and every cast gives 5 trials.

behaviours.name: Mojo High (additional Mimic Ward)
behaviours.quote: summons 1 additional
behaviours.observe_source: AscensionWitchDoctorSummons.cpp:189-190 (Summon): if (spell == Mimic) count = max(1, Effects[EFFECT_2].CalcValue(player)); Mimic Ward 707162 Effect[2] (SUMMON, MiscValue 300659) has DieSides 0 and Completion.cpp:250-251 pins its BasePoints to 1, so CalcValue is 1 ward. Mojo High 706488 Effect[0] aura 107 (SPELLMOD_EFFECT3, MiscValue 23, class mask 512 which Mimic Ward's SpellFamilyFlags[0] 8704 carries) has DieSides 1, so its modifier is +1 and Unit::ApplyEffectModifiers makes CalcValue 2. Both phases cast Mimic Ward at the caster, 706488 learned between them (control = before phase, 1 ward); a new cast despawns the earlier ward of the same slot (Summons.cpp:216-220), so the first phase's ward cannot inflate the count. Needs a first run to confirm the SPELLMOD reaches CalcValue(player); if the read is 1 the entry alerts and points at that path.

behaviours.observe_source: AscensionWitchDoctorAbilities.cpp:333-338 (OnSpellCast): else-if Family(info,0,536870912) (Spirit Eclipse 801607) { if (count == 5 && player->HasAura(PriceToPay)) { Reduce(player, Glaive, INT32_MAX); Cast(player, player, PriceReady); } }; Reduce (Completion.cpp:161-174) calls RemoveSpellCooldown on every known rank of Spirit Glaive 806289 (CategoryRecoveryTime 20000). count is the Spirit stacks at cast start: Mirage 501136 is the setup cast that makes 5 Spirits without set_aura. behaviours.name: Splash On Em (Loa's Brew reduces Mojo Beam cooldown)
behaviours.quote: by 2 sec.
behaviours.observe_source: AscensionWitchDoctorAbilities.cpp:328-329 (OnSpellCast): if (Family(info, 1, 131072) && player->HasAura(SplashOnEm)) Reduce(player, Beam, 2000); Loa's Brew 801670 has SpellFamilyFlags[1] 131072; Reduce is ModifySpellCooldown(-2000) on each known rank of Mojo Beam 500950 (RecoveryTime 14000). behaviours.name: Splash On Em (Mojo Beam recast after Loa's Brew)
behaviours.quote: reduces the cooldown of Mojo Beam by 2 sec.
behaviours.observe_source: AscensionWitchDoctorAbilities.cpp:328-329 (OnSpellCast): Family(info, 1, 131072) (Loa's Brew 801670) with 802219 known calls Reduce(player, Beam, 2000), ModifySpellCooldown(-2000) on every known rank of Mojo Beam 500950 (AscensionWitchDoctorCompletion.cpp:161-174); the hook runs when the 2000 ms Brew cast completes (cycle 1 read 10491 ms when it read too early). Mojo Beam RecoveryTime and CategoryRecoveryTime 14000 ms, a channel, cast at the caster (TARGET_UNIT_TARGET_ALLY). Each arm casts Mojo Beam, then Loa's Brew 2500 ms later (past the 1500 ms global cooldown; the Brew is cast in every arm and only 802219 differs), then attempts Mojo Beam at the stated cooldown plus or minus 500 ms counted from the Beam cast: without 802219 at 12500 ms it is refused (SPELL_FAILED_NOT_READY 67, 1500 ms left, the control), with it learned it goes through (0), and at 11500 ms with it it is refused again, so the cut is no larger than 2 sec. The Brew completes at 4500 ms, long before every attempt. This consumes the cooldown: the recast is accepted, which a cooldown_ms read does not show. Regeneration is off and cast_power sets the mana only before the Beam casts, while the Beam channel drains mana at a rising rate every 500 ms (AscensionWitchDoctorBrewing.cpp:191-198); at cast_power 1000 the Brew 2500 ms later was refused with SPELL_FAILED_NO_POWER in every arm (prove-c2s, lead-802219-recast.md), so cast_power is 2000 (below the 2567 maximum mana), leaving about 1175 mana for the Brew's 33% of about 1490 base mana. A Brew refused for mana would read as a missing cut.

Mirage is a real setup cast (M-9; instant, CastingTimeIndex 1, 29% mana, cooldown 180000 reset by the scenario) made at the caster in both phases, followed by a 1600 ms wait past the 1500 ms global cooldown (StartRecoveryTime 1500, category 133, shared with the Glaive), so the Glaive that follows is accepted. cast_power 1000 sets the mana before the setup cast (Mirage 29% plus Glaive 10% of about 1490 base mana). behaviours.name: Mirage (ended by direct healing)
behaviours.quote: Direct damage or healing done will end this effect.
behaviours.observe_source: Same hook as damage_ends (Abilities.cpp:277-278, the healing argument). Loa's Brew 801670 (2000 ms cast, CastingTimeIndex 5, SPELL_EFFECT_HEAL, TARGET_UNIT_TARGET_ALLY) is cast at the caster, held at 50% health so the heal is effective; read 3000 ms after the cast starts, 1000 ms after the heal lands. Control: the before phase makes the Mirage cast and no heal, and reads Mirage still on (1); after: 0. Calibrate on the first run: if the hook's healing argument is the effective heal only and the health fixture does not take, the read stays 1.

behaviours.name: Mirage (the invisible caster sees only invisible targets)
behaviours.quote: you can only see other invisible targets
behaviours.observe_source: The tooltip governs (G-1): an invisible caster sees only invisible targets and those who can see invisible. The reference dummy (creature 36) is visible and detects nothing invisible. Unit::CanSeeOrDetect(dummy) of the caster is read: before the cast (control) 1, after one real Mirage cast 0. No Witch Doctor code restricts the caster's sight: grep of AscensionWitchDoctor*.cpp finds Mirage only at Abilities.cpp:277-278, 345-352 and Auras.cpp:170, 335, 404 (stat, threat, speed, summon), and Mirage's only aura is Effect[0] 18 SPELL_AURA_MOD_INVISIBILITY, which in stock rules does not hide the world from its holder. A read of 1 after the cast is therefore a candidate defect for the lead, not a test fault. Readback entry (M-11): it reports data conformant, not behaviour.

behaviours.name: Soul Marionette (clones apply a stack)
behaviours.quote: applying a stack of Soul Marionette
behaviours.observe_source: AscensionWitchDoctorSummons.cpp:307-308 starts each of the 5 clones (entry 300661) with a 2000 ms timer; at the tick Summons.cpp:559-562 (++_marionetteTicks <= 4, player has Marionette) casts the stack aura 807057 on the caster, one stack per clone per tick, max 20 stacks (StackAmount 20). The first tick of all 5 clones falls at about 2000 ms, the second at about 4000 ms, so 3000 ms after the cast the caster holds exactly 5 stacks. Control: the uncast before phase reads 0 stacks of 807057.

behaviours.name: Soul Marionette stack (haste per stack)
behaviours.quote: Increases your haste by 1% per stack.
behaviours.observe_source: Completion.cpp:423-428 turns Effect[0] of 807057 into SPELL_AURA_HASTE_SPELLS with BasePoints 0 and DieSides 1 (1% per stack); SpellAuraEffects.cpp:659 multiplies the amount by the stack amount, so the 5 stacks of the stacks entry read an amount of 5 (5% haste). Control: the uncast before phase reads 0 (no aura). The amount is the aura effect's own value, the haste actually applied to the caster follows from it. Readback entry (M-11): it reports data conformant, not behaviour.

behaviours.name: Veil of Darkness (veil on the target for 15 sec)
behaviours.quote: increasing the damage you deal to them by $s1% for $d.
behaviours.observe_source: Cause of the cycle 1 flake (baseline 20261114-235616 aura present, 20261115-011935 absent, same build and scenario, both cast_failure 0 and cooldown 89982): Veil 802100 is a Shadow aura-only spell. SpellMgr.cpp:3929 sets SPELL_ATTR0_CU_BINARY_SPELL on it (Effect[0] aura 271 with a non-zero value), and the override at SpellMgr.cpp:4063-4099 that clears the flag for spells whose periodic trigger spell is not binary does not fire, because the contract has already turned Effect[1] into a periodic dummy with TriggerSpell 0 (Completion.cpp:284-285, run in LoadSpellInfoCorrections, World.cpp:415, before LoadSpellInfoCustomAttributes, World.cpp:429). A binary spell adds Unit::GetEffectiveResistChance to the full-resist roll (Unit.cpp:4092-4098): the level 60 dummy's linear monster resistance, 60 x CoA.MonsterResistance.PerLevel 1.0 / PerPercent 5.0 = 12%, a SPELL_MISS_RESIST that leaves cast_failure 0 and starts the cooldown. The spell hit roll cannot be the cause: Unit.cpp:4055-4062 caps the hit chance at 100% and the class file's spell_hit_rating 10000 reaches it. The resist is derived by reading the code, not observed: the value scenarios keep no combat log. Fixture: caster aura 823764 (beeg spellpen, SPELL_AURA_MOD_TARGET_RESISTANCE -9999 on all magic schools, the fixture of the hit and Crypt Plague entries) sets the dummy's effective resistance to 0 (Unit.cpp:2615-2622, 2625-2626), so the resist chance is 0. 823764 is a phase aura of both phases, not the cause. Control: the uncast before phase reads the aura absent. After one real cast: held at 14700 ms, gone at 15300 ms, inside the G-19 band 14250 to 15750 ms around $d = 15000 ms (SpellDuration 8) in game time.

behaviours.name: Sen'jin's Wisdom (Mirage lasts twice as long)
behaviours.quote: Doubles the duration of
behaviours.observe_source: Native effect, no script: 504774 Effect[0] SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER, MiscValue 1 (SPELLMOD_DURATION), +20000 ms (BasePoints 19999 + DieSides 1), class mask [2] 1073741824 = Mirage's SpellFamilyFlags[2] 1073741824; Mirage DurationIndex 18 = 20000 ms, so a doubling. Each phase casts Mirage at the caster and reads the aura's remaining duration 100 ms later; 504774 is learned between the phases (control: the before phase, about 19900 ms). Judged as the after reading over the before reading, 2 within 0.02 (about 39900 over 19900 = 2.005), so the clock overhead cancels. expire_ms 2000 puts the second Mirage cast past the 1500 ms global cooldown of the first (the Mirage cooldown itself is reset by the scenario); the first Mirage aura is still running and the recast refreshes it. Readback entry (M-11): it reports data conformant, not behaviour.

behaviours.name: Spirit Hunting (extra Spirit per Malefic Arrow, 15% per Spirit)
behaviours.quote: Each active Spirit gives you a 15% chance when you cast Malefic Arrow to generate an additional Spirit.
behaviours.observe_source: AscensionWitchDoctorAbilities.cpp:313-314 (OnSpellCast, non-triggered cast): if (IsArrow(info) && player->HasAura(SpiritHunting) && roll_chance_i(count * 15)) GainSpirit(player); count is the 561136 stack count snapshotted in OnSpellBeforeEffects (Abilities.cpp:101), which Spell.cpp:4044 calls before OnSpellCast (Spell.cpp:4191). GainSpirit (Completion.cpp:137-150) casts 561136 once, also at the 5-stack cap, so spell_cast_count of 561136 counts every extra Spirit; set_aura uses AddAura and casts nothing. Malefic Arrow 801674: IsArrow (SpellFamilyFlags[1] 0x80008000, Completion.h:372-375), not Family(1,4), so it grants no Spirit of its own; castable with ArrowTalent 707854 known (Abilities.cpp:83), needs the bow (EquippedItemSubClassMask 262156), instant (CastTime -1000000), GCD 1500, 8000 ms cooldown reset each cast, 5% base mana. cast_power 1000 is unverified for the bow: the 2567 maximum mana read in compare-c1 was taken with the reference weapon 72038, not the bow, and a set_power above the maximum errors the scenario rather than misjudging it. 707504 is passive with ProcFlags 0, so its native aura 42 (trigger 561136) never fires. Tooltip literal 15% per Spirit. Judged on each arm total (mentor M-1, ADR 0662 provisional), each arm sized flip-proof (mentor M-14/M-14a): n >= p(1-p)((2.576 + 3.719)/band)^2, the Wilson 99% interval of a true total chance leaving its band at most 1e-4 per edge; 5 Spirits 75% (band 3.75 points) needs 5284 casts, 4 Spirits 60% (band 3 points) needs 10568, the two cheapest stack counts; 9 parts of 588 and 1175 (5292 and 10575 per run), about 47.6 game minutes each, 428.7 per run (Witch Doctor ADR 0001).

behaviours.name: Loa Spirits (Reclamation casts an additional time, 5% per Spirit)
behaviours.quote: For each active Spirit on you, you have a $561361s1% chance for your Reclamation to cast an additional time.
behaviours.observe_source: AscensionWitchDoctorAbilities.cpp:305-309 (OnSpellCast, non-triggered cast): Family(info,1,4) (Reclamation 806288, SpellFamilyFlags[1] 268435460) -> GainSpirit(player), then if (player->HasAura(LoaEcho) && target && roll_chance_i(count * 5)) Cast(player, target, id); the recast is triggered, so OnSpellCast returns before a second GainSpirit and no recast rolls again. spell_cast_count counts every cast of 806288, triggered or not, so events are the 806288 casts less one per trial, and trials are the 561136 casts (one per player Reclamation). Tooltip $561361s1: 561361 EffectBasePoints[0] 4 + DieSides 1 = 5% per Spirit. 705843 is passive with ProcFlags 0, so its native aura 42 (trigger 707422, which re-triggers 806288, ProcChance 1) does not fire; if it came alive, the 0-stack control would catch it with probability 1 - 0.99^n, 99.9992% for the 1170 control casts of one run (13 parts of 90). Reclamation: cast 1800 ms + 500 ranged, GCD 1500, no cooldown, 8% base mana, bow; cast_power 1000 is unverified for the bow (the 2567 maximum mana of compare-c1 was read with the reference weapon 72038, not the bow). Judged on each arm total (mentor M-1, ADR 0662 provisional), each arm sized flip-proof (mentor M-14/M-14a): n >= p(1-p)((t + 3.719)/band)^2 with the between-part t quantile 3.055 (12 df), the 99% interval of a true total chance leaving its band at most 1e-4 per edge; 1 Spirit 5% needs 5449 casts and 2 Spirits 10% need 10324 (band 2 points each), the two cheapest stack counts; 13 parts of 420 and 795 (5460 and 10335 per run), about 54.8 game minutes each, 712.3 per run (Witch Doctor ADR 0001). Both arms also alert on a roll that counts the Spirit this Reclamation grants (10% and 15%).

behaviours.name: A Price To Pay (Spirit Glaive cooldown cleared on the client)
behaviours.quote: now resets the cooldown of
behaviours.observe_source: AscensionWitchDoctorAbilities.cpp:333-338 (OnSpellCast): Spirit Eclipse 801607 (Family 0 536870912) cast with count == 5 Spirits and 705948 known calls Reduce(player, Glaive, INT32_MAX); AscensionWitchDoctorCompletion.cpp:161-174 sends it as Player::RemoveSpellCooldown(806289, true) (Player.cpp:3949-3955: erase the cooldown, then SendClearCooldown), so the client is told the Glaive may be cast again: one SMSG_CLEAR_COOLDOWN (0x1DE, 478) whose first field is 806289, counted by server_packets with row 806289 (the harness registers the row from the step, CoAGameplayTest.cpp:2130-2135, ObserveExtensionPacket :1385-1389). Same real setup as the reset entry: Glaive (2000 ms cast), then Mirage 501136 (instant, 5 real Spirits through GainSpirit, Abilities.cpp:345-346; the trigger's own required Spirit aura is set before the setup casts, so Mirage's five stacks are the count of 5), 2000 ms apart, then Eclipse (count read at cast start, Abilities.cpp:101). The count is cumulative and every harness reset_cooldown of 806289 sends the same packet (RemoveSpellCooldown with update true), so each phase holds exactly one fixture clear before the Glaive cast: before phase (705948 unknown, the control) 1; after phase 1 + 1 fixture clear of the second phase + 1 from the talent = 3; without the talent it would read 2. This is the event the server sends when the cooldown is cleared, not a recast: the recast acceptance read (cost_gate resets, arms refused without and accepted with) is not expressible with real Spirits, because cost_gate re-sets 561136 to 1 stack right before an after cast of Eclipse (values.py:190-193, behaviours.py:3995-4000), so Eclipse would see 1 Spirit, not 5; it needs the keep_required_aura owner tool.

behaviours.name: Soul Marionette (Malefic Wrath cast held at 1715 ms under 15 stacks)
behaviours.quote: applying a stack of Soul Marionette.
behaviours.observe_source: The quote is the stack sentence of 704497; the ledger clause the labels attach to, Increases your haste by 1% per stack., is the 807038 text embedded in the 704497 tooltip (@s:807038:0@), which the quote check cannot match, and the stack it describes is what this entry exercises. Soul Marionette 704497 casts 5 clones (Summons.cpp:177-193, 5 x NpcMarionette 300661); each has a 2000 ms timer (Summons.cpp:307-308) and at each tick, up to 4 times, casts the stack aura 807057 on the caster (Summons.cpp:559-562), 5 stacks per tick, so the ticks at about 2000, 4000, 6000 and 8000 ms leave 5, 10, 15 and 20 stacks. 807057 is raw DBC Effect[1] SPELL_AURA_HASTE_SPELLS (216), but Completion.cpp:423-428 rewrites Effect[0] to SPELL_AURA_HASTE_SPELLS (base 0, die 1, 1% per stack) and zeroes Effect[1], so the effective haste effect is Effect[0] (the aura_amount of the haste entry reads 5 at 5 stacks), which Unit::ApplyCastTimePercentMod turns into UNIT_MOD_CAST_SPEED 1 / 1.15 at 15 stacks. Malefic Wrath 807037 (CastingTimeIndex 5 = 2000 ms, DmgClass 1 magic, RangeIndex 4 = 0..30 yd, no cooldown, no category, 1500 ms global cooldown, 11% mana, not the Glaive's family flag) is the cast whose time is read: Unit::ModSpellCastTime (Unit.cpp:13056-13068) multiplies a DmgClass 1 cast by UNIT_MOD_CAST_SPEED. The Spirit Glaive is not used: Unit.cpp:13045-13047 divides its cast time by an Agility term. The after phase casts Marionette for real (setup_only_after, the entry's own spell) and starts the Wrath 6120 ms later, after the 6000 ms tick (stacks 15) and early enough that the cast, with 15% haste 2000 / 1.15 = 1739 ms, ends before the 8000 ms tick (20 stacks). Control (before phase): no Marionette, the same Wrath cast: 2000 ms. Read 1715 ms nominal, about 1725 to 1732 ms of game time after the cast starts (G-19: the larger of 5% and 2 points around 15%, 13..17%: 2000 / 1.17 = 1709 to 2000 / 1.13 = 1770 ms): casting in both phases (the held half, as Necromancer Scourge Disciple 531126 cast_held). The after reading's game time must lie in the band, else alert.

behaviours.name: Soul Marionette (Malefic Wrath cast done at 1752 ms under 15 stacks)
behaviours.quote: applying a stack of Soul Marionette.
behaviours.observe_source: As the haste_cast_held entry: the read at 1752 ms nominal, about 1762 to 1769 ms of game time after the Malefic Wrath cast starts, falls inside the G-19 band 1709..1770 ms. Without Marionette the 2000 ms cast is still running (casting 1, the control); with 15 stacks (15% haste, 1739 ms, ending on the first 25 ms server step at or after 1739 ms) the cast is done (casting 0). Together with haste_cast_held the cast with haste ends in (1715, 1770] ms of game time, 13 to 17 percent faster than 2000 ms.

behaviours.name: Mirage (the invisible caster no longer has the visible dummy at its client)
behaviours.quote: you can only see other invisible targets
behaviours.observe_source: The tooltip governs (G-1): an invisible caster sees only invisible targets and those who can see invisible. Mirage's Effect[0] is SPELL_AURA_MOD_INVISIBILITY (type 0, general); AuraEffect::HandleModInvisibility (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:1912) ends with Unit::UpdateObjectVisibility(forced true, fromUpdate true), which for a Player runs Unit::UpdateObjectVisibility and UpdateVisibilityForPlayer at once (PlayerUpdates.cpp:1735-1752): the caster's own visible set is rebuilt with CanSeeOrDetect(target, false, true) for every object in range, and WorldObject::CanDetectInvisibilityOf (Object.cpp:2001-2062) refuses a seer that is invisible to a target that cannot detect invisibility (the dummy, creature 36, detects none), so the dummy leaves the caster's client-visible set. nearby_creature_at_client reads Player::HaveAtClient for the nearest living creature 36 (CoAGameplayTest.cpp:4635-4640): the event the server applied to the client, not the CanSeeOrDetect predicate the sight entry reads. Control (before phase, cast_in_before false): the dummy (creature 36, spawned by the generator because the entry sets select_dummy, selected and settled 5000 ms) is at the client (1); after one real Mirage and 1000 ms the read is 0. A read of 1 after the cast would contradict the tooltip: a candidate defect lead (M-13), not a test fault. The Templar detection client entry steps the caster aside and back before each read because the dummy's own aura change runs no visibility update; here the caster's own aura change does (the forced update above), so no step is made. Calibrate the before read on the first run: a before reading of 0 means the dummy was never in the client set.

behaviours.name: Krag'wa's Blessing (Amphibimorph is instant cast)
behaviours.quote: Your Amphibimorph is now instant cast.
behaviours.observe_source: 807855 Effect[0] is SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (108), misc 10 SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME, -101 on the class mask 2147483648 of Amphibimorph 500952 (SpellFamilyFlags[0] 2147483648): Unit::ModSpellCastTime applies the SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME modifier to the cast time, which falls to 0, so Amphibimorph casts at once. Amphibimorph (CastingTimeIndex 4 = 1000 ms, DmgClass 1, cooldown 120000 reset by the scenario, range 0..30 yd, 18% mana) is a real cast at the dummy in both phases. Control (before phase, 807855 unknown): the 1000 ms cast is still running 300 ms after it starts (casting 1). After 807855 is learned: the cast was instant, so nothing is being cast 300 ms later (casting 0). expire_ms 2500 lets the control cast finish before the second phase.

behaviours.quote: Instantly swaps your Ingredients to Jungle Shrooms and Bloodthistle.

behaviours.name: Splash On 'Em (Mojo Beam heals cut the Potion Toss cooldown)
behaviours.quote: Effective healing done by Mojo Beam now reduces the cooldown of Potion Toss and Splash Potion by 1 sec.
behaviours.observe_source: AscensionWitchDoctorBrewing.cpp:129-152 (Mojo Beam 500950 Heal): each heal with an effective amount and 802219 known calls Reduce(player, Potion 801661, 1000) and Reduce(player, Splash 802710, 1000), ModifySpellCooldown(-1000) on every known rank (AscensionWitchDoctorCompletion.cpp:161-174). Gated: 801661 (CategoryRecoveryTime 15000, RecoveryTime 0, server DBC set), castable once Ingredient: Bloodthistle 801664 is cast for real (Abilities.cpp:74-75 refuses a potion without an ingredient; the 801702 CasterAuraSpell is also set by required_aura_steps, a precondition fixture). Mojo Beam: a channel (DurationIndex 31 = 8000 ms) at the caster, one heal every 500 ms (EffectAmplitude[0]), no other ally so no branch; cancelled by cancel_aura after 3000 ms (about six heals), so the cut stops before the attempts and the per-heal bracket is (15000 - elapsed) / heals. Caster health set to 1% of the 10000 fixture maximum before the Beam (precondition fixture) so every heal is effective; the verdict checks no overheal. Expected recast about 15000 - 6 x 1000 = 9000 ms after the first cast (10000 with five heals); attempts every 100 ms from 6500 to 12000 ms, after the Beam's 1500 ms global cooldown. Control without 802219: every attempt refused with 67 (not ready; the plain cooldown ends at 15000). Ineffective arm, 802219 kept: the caster at full health (10000 of the 10000 fixture maximum), so every Beam heal is overhealing (Brewing.cpp:148-152 cuts only for an effective amount) and the verdict requires 0 effective healing; attempts every 500 ms from 6500 to 12000 ms must all read 67, so a cut on every heal (recast near 9000 ms) alerts. Beam mana: ManaCostPercentage 15 plus the rising per-tick drain (Brewing.cpp:191-198); cast_power 2000 before each cast, below the 2567 maximum.

behaviours.name: Cauldron Brewer (a brew is crafted)
behaviours.quote: crafting a brew
behaviours.observe_source: Potion Toss 801661 ("Fill a potion from your Cauldron, and toss it at a friendly target"; instant, 18% mana, 15000 ms category cooldown reset by the scenario) has CasterAuraSpell 801702, the Has Ingredient Marker, which AscensionWitchDoctorBrewing.cpp:38-45 (SyncIngredients) casts only while an Ingredient is active and Cauldron Brewer 92085 is known. With Ingredient: Frog Bones 801663 active, AscensionWitchDoctorAbilities.cpp:236-243 (OnSpellHit, IsPotion) casts the Ingredient's brew on the target (PotionEffects, AscensionWitchDoctorBrewing.cpp:89-107): the Frog Bones potion 802971, an absorb shield (Frog Bones: "Potion: Grants target ally an absorption shield"). Both phases cast a real Frog Bones and then a real Potion Toss at the caster (1700 ms after, past the 1500 ms global cooldown; cast_power 1000 covers 5% plus 18% of about 1490 base mana). The before phase (92085 unknown, the control) has no marker, the cast is refused and 802971 reads 0; the after phase (92085 learned between) reads 802971 on the caster, 1. The outcome is the crafted brew. The harness sets the Has Ingredient Marker 801702 with set_aura before the setup cast in both phases, because it is the CasterAuraSpell of Potion Toss (a precondition fixture, the subject is the brew); the server removes it again on the Frog Bones cast when 92085 is unknown (SyncIngredients), which is what the control reads, and brew_marker proves that 92085 grants the marker without the fixture.

behaviours.name: Cauldron Brewer (an Ingredient prepares a brew)
behaviours.quote: You may now prepare Ingredients into a Cauldron, crafting a brew.
behaviours.observe_source: AscensionWitchDoctorBrewing.cpp:38-45 (SyncIngredients): with an Ingredient active and Cauldron Brewer 92085 known, the caster gets the Has Ingredient Marker 801702 (the CasterAuraSpell of Potion Toss 801661 and the gate of the Cauldron effects); without 92085 it is removed. Both phases brew Ingredient: Frog Bones 801663 for real (instant, 5% mana, 500 ms category, 1500 ms GCD, 1700 ms settle): the control reads the marker absent (0) with an Ingredient and without 92085. 92085 is learned between the phases and Ingredient: Bloodthistle 801664 is cast, which swaps the Ingredient (capacity 1) and runs SyncIngredients with the Brewer: the marker reads 1.

behaviours.name: Cauldron Brewer (one of each Ingredient)
behaviours.quote: Only 1 of each Ingredient
behaviours.observe_source: Per-kind limit: Ingredient: Frog Bones 801663 has StackAmount 3 in Spell.dbc, and the code sets StackAmount 1 on every Ingredient (AscensionWitchDoctorCompletion.cpp:384-388). behaviours.reason: Ingredient: Fish Oil 801662 (instant, TARGET_UNIT_CASTER, SpellFamilyName 19, 500 ms category) has Effect[1] SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_TRIGGER_SPELL of 803269 every 1500 ms on the caster (Spell.dbc); 803269 (DurationIndex 39 = 2000 ms) has two SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AREA_AURA_RAID effects (aura 31 and aura 58, +10%, EffectRadiusIndex 23 = 40 yd), so the caster's own area-aura update puts 803269 on a grouped ally in range. The Ingredient is the active brew of 92085's 'Nearby allies are buffed based on the active brew' (the Brewer only gates the potion marker, AscensionWitchDoctorBrewing.cpp:38-45, so no Brewer learn is needed for the area part). The Ingredient is cast for real at the caster, the ally is grouped (kind aura_presence) and read 4500 ms after the cast. Inside arm: the ally stands 35 yd away and must gain the aura (it reads 0 before the cast). Control arm: the ally stands 45 yd away, beyond the 40 yd radius, and must stay without it while the caster carries it (the 'caster' expectation). Player report #11066 (the cosmetic cauldron on the back) is a visual and is outside this clause. Scope of the proof: these entries do not learn the Brewer 92085 (aura_presence learns only the Ingredient it casts, behaviours.py:2349, and has no learn field), and no Brewer gate sits on the area fields, so they prove the Ingredient's own Cauldron area aura (803269 / 803697) and would also pass without 92085; the radius control arm is what they show. A learn field on aura_presence is tool note T6.

behaviours.name: Hexfire (snaps Puppeteer's Threads: the aura is gone)
behaviours.quote: snapping your Puppeteer's Threads, unleashing its damage instantly
behaviours.observe_source: Hexfire 573026 (instant, 17% mana, 10000 ms category, SpellFamilyFlags[1] 262144) hits the dummy: AscensionWitchDoctorAbilities.cpp:259-266 (OnSpellHitResult): with Voodoo Spirits 704511 known ($?s704511) a Hexfire hit that finds Puppeteer's Threads 572836 of the caster on the target casts Threads damage 572837 with the stored amount, zeroes the amount and removes the aura (and grants a Spirit). Puppeteer 92084 (learned from the start, a real learn) is the Threads source: AscensionWitchDoctorEvents.cpp:77-79 (Check) and :132-141 (Proc) put 572836 on the target after the first non-periodic damage and add 15% of each later hit to it (DurationIndex 1 = 10000 ms). Both phases cast Malefic Wrath 807037 for real at the dummy (the setup cast, 2000 ms, direct non-periodic damage that puts the Threads on; Hexfire has a 10000 ms category cooldown, so it cannot be its own setup cast), wait 2500 ms, cast Hexfire for real and read 1000 ms after it. Control (before phase): 704511 not known, the Hexfire leaves the Threads on the dummy and no Threads damage has landed; after phase: 704511 learned between the phases. The whole scenario stays under the 10000 ms of the first Threads. The damage formula of the clause is a separate token (573026 effect_value, unreadable by tooltip.py: $cond/$gt/$spfi/$spn). This entry reads Puppeteer's Threads 572836 on the dummy: 1 without 704511 (control), 0 with it (snapped). A Hexfire that never snaps leaves the Threads, so it reads 1 and fails.

behaviours.name: Umbral Glaive (curses up to 2 nearby enemies besides the target)
behaviours.quote: curses an enemy and up to 2 nearby enemies
behaviours.radius_reason: the tooltip gives no radius for 'nearby'; the extra dummies stand within 8 yd of the primary, inside the 10 yd the script searches (AscensionWitchDoctorAbilities.cpp:116-128), and the far dummy 5 yd beyond that
behaviours.observe_source: Umbral Glaive 501134 (instant, 9% mana, DmgClass ranged, Effect[0] SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_LEECH on the target; Effect[1] zeroed at load, AscensionWitchDoctorCompletion.cpp:447-453): AscensionWitchDoctorAbilities.cpp:116-128 (OnSpellBeforeEffects) adds the first two valid attackable enemies in line of sight within 10 yd of the target to Effect[0] (MaxAffectedTargets 3). The cast is gated by the ready buff 504588 (OnSpellCheckCast), which the scenario sets before the cast (named precondition fixture: the buff is the product of a ranged-hit roll, proven by the ready entry; a real proc would force the roll in this scenario). One cast at the primary dummy 3 yd out, four more dummies inside 8 yd of it (two more than the stated 2) and one beyond: the aura 501134 of the caster is read on every dummy 500 ms after the cast; the primary and exactly two of the four extra dummies carry it (3 in all, count_primary) and the far one does not. Player report #1506 does not name this part.

behaviours.name: Umbral Glaive (scales with modifiers to Hex of Malice: Prolonged Malice doubles its duration)
behaviours.quote: Scales with modifiers to Hex of Malice.
behaviours.observe_source: Prolonged Malice 704505 (passive, Effect[0] SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER SPELLMOD_DURATION +6000 ms, EffectBasePoints 5999 + DieSides 1) is a native modifier of the Hex of Malice family (SpellFamilyFlags[1] 33554432); AscensionWitchDoctorCompletion.cpp:447-450 gives Umbral Glaive 501134 that family flag, so the modifier reaches it. Each phase sets the ready buff 504588 (named precondition fixture) and casts Umbral Glaive (instant, Speed 30, the dummy 3 yd out: the projectile lands about 100 ms after the cast) at the dummy, then reads the remaining duration of 501134 500 ms after the cast, 400 ms after the aura has landed; 704505 is learned between the phases (control: the before phase, DurationIndex 32 = 6000 ms, about 5500 left). With it the duration is 6000 + 6000 = 12000 (about 11500 left). Judged as the gain, after minus before, which does not depend on the elapsed time: 6000 within 300 (the G-19 band of 5% of 6000 ms); the before reading must reach 5000 so a missing aura (0) cannot pass. A missing modifier gains 0. Readback entry (M-11): it reports data conformant, not behaviour.

behaviours.name: Mojo Beam (Potion Toss costs 20% more while channeling)
behaviours.quote: $573288s1% increased cost
behaviours.observe_source: AscensionWitchDoctorBrewing.cpp:113-127 (aura_ascension_witch_doctor_beam::Apply) casts Mojo Beam 573288 on the caster at the apply of the Beam aura and gives it the Beam's remaining duration; Completion.cpp:347-354 gives 573288 Effect[0] the class mask (0, 2048, 536870913) that Potion Toss 801661 (SpellFamilyFlags[1] 526336), Splash Potion 802710 (SpellFamilyFlags[2] 536870912) and Spirit in a Bottle 801696 (SpellFamilyFlags[2] 1) carry: Effect[0] aura 108 SPELLMOD_COST BasePoints 19 + 1 = +20% ($573288s1), Effect[1] SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME -10001; Unit.cpp:5096-5121 (CanCastDuringChannel) lets the three be cast during a Mojo Beam channel (SpellFamilyFlags[1] 4194304) and Unit::ModSpellCastTime (Unit.cpp:13040-13043) sets their cast time to 0. Mojo Beam 501117: CastingTimeIndex 1 (instant), RecoveryTime 14000 reset by the scenario, GCD 1500, ManaCostPercentage 15 (about 224 of about 1490 base mana), DurationIndex 31 (8000 ms channel). cast_power 2000 is set before the cast (below the 2567 maximum); the caster is the target, so no dummy stands in the scenario. The read is taken 1000 ms after the cast, two heals into the channel (the cost drain ends it near 5500 ms, AscensionWitchDoctorBrewing.cpp:186-196, well after the read). Control: the before phase casts nothing, with the channel absent. before_expected 100 is only the floor of the before reading (ManaCostPercentage x about 1490 base mana is at least 223 for every spell here), so a zero cost cannot hide the ratio. Potion Toss 801661 costs 18% of the base mana; spell_power_cost reads SpellInfo::CalcPowerCost for the caster, which applies the SPELLMOD_COST modifiers of the auras on it, so the ratio of the cost during the channel to the uncast cost is 1.20, judged inside the G-19 band (the larger of 5% and 2 points of +20% is 2 points). Same subject as the data label 573288e0 #3. Player reports #11216 and #10994 (the mana cost of Mojo Beam and its branches) concern the per-tick drain of clause 42, not this 20% (see the author report).

behaviours.name: Mojo Beam (heals 277 every 0.5 sec)
behaviours.quote: healing for ${$m1+0+$SP*0.1073} every $T1 sec
behaviours.observe_source: AscensionWitchDoctorBrewing.cpp:167-213 (Tick): one heal of effect 0 amount per branch every 500 ms (Completion.cpp:339-343 makes Effect[0] a 500 ms periodic dummy, AttributesEx5 loses SPELL_ATTR5_SPELL_HASTE_AFFECTS_PERIODIC), Heal (Brewing.cpp:129-165) calls SpellHealingBonusDone with the coefficient row 501117 0.1073 x spell power (AscensionWitchDoctorCoefficients.h:34) and HealBySpell, which the harness records in spell_heal_total {spell 501117, target caster}. The reference caster has 0 spell power, so the amount is 276 + 1 = 277 (tooltip $m1+0+$SP*0.1073 reads [=277] with the reference stats, packet token list). No ally stands in the scenario: the only branch is the caster, who is the Beam target. Heal critical hits are random, so Reg's Test Aura 984954 (spell crit -1000, the Necromancer's no-crit precondition fixture) is set on the caster in both phases: a crit is a different amount, not a different period. The first tick lands 500 ms after the apply (no start-at-apply flag), so 3200 ms of cast-start game time hold ticks at 500, 1000, 1500, 2000, 2500 and 3000: six heals, 6 x 277 = 1662 (five would read 1385, seven 1939). cast_power 2000 before the cast covers the opening 15% (about 224) and the drain of six ticks (about 1190, Brewing.cpp:191-196). Control: the before phase casts nothing and reads 0. This entry is the unhasted baseline of the haste entry (same scenario with Bloodlust set on the caster). Period bound (G-19, reviewer M-4): six heals by the 3200 ms read bound the period to (457, 533] ms (3200 / 7 and 3200 / 6). The excluded periods are 457 ms or less (seven or more heals) and above 533 ms (five or fewer); this interval is wider than the G-19 band of 5% of 500 ms (475 to 525 ms). The exact period is carried by the data label 501117 aura_amplitude_ms #1 (500 ms); this entry proves the heals really come at that cadence within those bounds.

The reference caster has 0 spell power, so the amount is 276 + 1 = 277 (tooltip $m1+0+$SP*0.1073 reads [=277] with the reference stats, packet token list). No ally stands in the scenario: the only branch is the caster, who is the Beam target. Heal critical hits are random, so Reg's Test Aura 984954 (spell crit -1000, the Necromancer's no-crit precondition fixture) is set on the caster in both phases: a crit is a different amount, not a different period. The first tick lands 500 ms after the apply (no start-at-apply flag), so 3200 ms of cast-start game time hold ticks at 500, 1000, 1500, 2000, 2500 and 3000: six heals, 6 x 277 = 1662 (five would read 1385, seven 1939). cast_power 2000 before the cast covers the opening 15% (about 224) and the drain of six ticks (about 1190, Brewing.cpp:191-196). Control: the before phase casts nothing and reads 0. Bloodlust 2825 (Effect[0] aura 65 casting speed, base 19 + 1 = +20%; harness set_aura on the caster, a precondition fixture: the subject is the Beam's period, haste is only present, and a real cast of 2825 is a Shaman spell the class cannot cast) would leave 7 periods (3200 / 416) if the period followed the haste, so the same 1662 read as heal_ticks proves the period is not shortened. The control arm of this clause is heal_ticks (identical scenario without the haste aura, same reading); a hasted period would read 1939 and alert. The core flag removal (Completion.cpp:342) is a no-op for the DBC, since 501117 AttributesEx5 is 0 (the haste flag is absent from the start); the claim is therefore met by the DBC, and what the entry guards is a script or aura that shortens the period under haste. behaviours.observe_source: Player report #10643: the Bloodthistle buff falls off while Jungle Shrooms and Fish Oil stay. Ingredient: Bloodthistle 801664 is an infinite aura (DurationIndex 21, forced by AscensionWitchDoctorCompletion.cpp:384-388) whose only effect is a periodic trigger every 1500 ms (EffectAmplitude[0], no SPELL_ATTR5_EXTRA_INITIAL_PERIOD) of the Cauldron buff 802771 (APPLY_AREA_AURA_RAID, aura 118 +8% healing taken, DurationIndex 39 = 2000 ms). 802771 has PreventionType 1 (silence); the Fish Oil and Frog Bones fields 803269 and 803697 and the Jungle Shrooms pulse 802703 have 0. Spell.cpp:6240-6243 runs CheckCasterAuras(preventionOnly) for a triggered spell with a prevention type whose triggering aura is positive, and Spell.cpp:7157-7160 refuses it while the caster has UNIT_FLAG_SILENCED. So while the Witch Doctor is silenced the refresh fails and 802771 lapses within 2000 ms; the other Cauldron effects keep refreshing. The tooltip states no exception (G-1), so the expected reading is 1. Before phase (no Ingredient cast, the control for the read): 802771 absent (0); the Spell Lock of the striker lands there too. expire_ms 14000: that first silence ends 3000 ms after it lands and the second lands about 19800 ms after the first, more than 15000 ms after the first ended, so the diminishing return of DIMINISHING_SILENCE (Spell Lock Mechanic 9, DRTYPE_PLAYER: SpellMgr.cpp:287-288, Unit.cpp:13087-13096, Spell.cpp:3181-3188) has reset and the second silence lasts the full 3000 ms. After phase: Mixologist 561069 is learned from the start (capacity 2, AscensionWitchDoctorBrewing.cpp:31, as in the 92085 max_two entry), Ingredient: Fish Oil 801662 is cast for real (setup cast: instant, 5% mana, StartRecoveryTime 1500 in category 130 shared with Bloodthistle, CategoryRecoveryTime 500: setup_wait_ms 1600), then Ingredient: Bloodthistle 801664 for real (instant, 5% mana), its first refresh 1500 ms later, then a passive striker (react state 0, spell_hit_bonus 100) casts the stock silence Spell Lock 24259 at the caster 1700 ms after the cast (aura 27, DurationIndex 27 = 3000 ms, DmgClass 0); the read comes 2600 ms into the silence, after the 802771 from the 1500 ms refresh has expired (3500 ms after the cast) and before the silence ends (4700 ms). Guards (after_auras_present), read on the caster right before the after reading: Spell Lock 24259 must be present (the silence landed and still holds), and the Fish Oil Cauldron buff 803269 must be present (the control arm: Fish Oil ticks about 1400 and 2900 ms after the Bloodthistle cast, the second inside the silence, so 803269 holds at the read only if a PreventionType 0 refresh survives the silence; without that refresh it would have lapsed about 3400 ms after the cast). A missing guard reads unmeasured. With both guards present, a silence-gated Bloodthistle refresh reads 0 (alert, the candidate defect lead #10643 describes) and 1 means the buff survives a silence. Evidence class: the read is aura presence, a readback for this healing claim (G-21 amendment point 1), so evidence_metric aura_amount (a coverage.METRIC_EVIDENCE readback) stamps it: an ok adds a data label and cannot lift the Cauldron claim to status 1; only an applied heal could.

behaviours.name: Spirit Eclipse (one hit for each active Spirit)
behaviours.quote: for each active Spirit.
behaviours.observe_source: AscensionWitchDoctorAbilities.cpp:143-149 (OnCalcMaxDuration: the Eclipse aura lasts 250 ms x the Spirits the caster has), AscensionWitchDoctorAuras.cpp:227-229 (on apply the aura stores _spirits = Spirits(player), the stack count of 561136) and :287-296 (Tick: one 802717 hit per tick while _ticks < _spirits, then Remove()). Spirit Eclipse 811117 (rank 7): instant, CategoryRecoveryTime 10000 reset by the scenario, GCD 1500, 12% mana, CasterAuraSpell 561136 (Spirit, StackAmount 5; one stack set by the harness before every cast), Effect[0] aura 227 every 250 ms ($t1). The treatment phase makes Spirits with a real Mirage 501136 (instant, 29% mana, RecoveryTime 180000 reset, GCD 1500; AscensionWitchDoctorAbilities.cpp:345-346 GainSpirit(player, 5): the one fixture stack plus five, capped at 5), so the Eclipse cast 1700 ms later strikes five times. The control phase makes none (setup_only_after) and keeps the single fixture Spirit, one hit. The caster's 802717 damage events on the dummy are counted cumulatively: 1 after the first phase and 1 + 5 = 6 after the second. Repair (cycle 7, author C): in both final04 runs the Eclipse after Mirage failed with SPELL_FAILED_BAD_TARGETS (reason 12, cast 3; the cast record shows target_visible false and target_check 12). Mirage's Effect[0] is SPELL_AURA_MOD_INVISIBILITY type 0, and its tooltip says 'While invisible, you can only see other invisible targets and those who can see invisible'. WorldObject::CanDetectInvisibilityOf (Object.cpp:2034-2041) refuses an invisible seer a target that does not detect its invisibility, and the Mirage sight entry of this class already proves this. The server was right and the test was wrong. Before each Eclipse cast, in both phases, the dummy casts Detect Invisibility 132 on itself for real (target_casts_before, with the 300 ms settle; Effect[0] aura 19 SPELL_AURA_MOD_INVISIBILITY_DETECT, MiscValue 0, amount 1000, TARGET_UNIT_TARGET_ALLY, DurationIndex 6). The harness casts a creature's spell with TRIGGERED_FULL_MASK (CoAGameplayTest.cpp:7639), so the dummy needs no mana and no GCD, and the cast is the same kind of real self-cast that the Witch Hunter witchblood_seen entry uses for its stealth. It is a precondition of the target, not the subject of the claim. HandleModInvisibilityDetect (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:1827-1839) adds the general flag, so the objMask check at Object.cpp:2036-2040 passes and the invisible caster may target the dummy, as the tooltip allows for 'those who can see invisible'. Guide 3.4: the real cast costs about the same as a set_aura (one 300 ms settle per phase), so the cast is used. behaviours.name: Sentry Ward (a stealthed enemy 3 yd away becomes detectable)
behaviours.quote: reveals all stealthed and invisible enemies near it
behaviours.observe_source: Sentry Ward 674303 (#12534, "doesnt work at all"): instant, GCD 1000, ManaCost 25 plus ManaCostPercentage 15, DurationIndex 3 = 60000 ms, summon creature 51104 at TARGET_DEST_CASTER_FRONT (SQL rev_20260909_00_witch_doctor_completion.sql:166-167 binds the summon script). AscensionWitchDoctorSummons.cpp:521-528: every second the ward takes Nearby(me, 30 yd) and, for each unit the owner is hostile to and the ward has in line of sight, player->AddAura(SentryReveal 505173, enemy) with duration 2200 ms, then removes the enemy's SPELL_AURA_MOD_STEALTH and SPELL_AURA_MOD_INVISIBILITY auras. Completion.cpp:546-551 rewrites 505173 to one SPELL_AURA_MOD_STALKED effect (aura 68), and Unit::IsAlwaysDetectableFor (Unit.cpp:12410-12416) makes a unit carrying it always detectable by the aura caster, ahead of every stealth check in WorldObject::CanDetect (Object.cpp:1975). Stealth Dummy 2144558 (aura 16, stealth 1000000) hides the dummy 3 yd away. The harness sets it on the dummy at the start of both phases. It is a precondition fixture: the subject of the claim is the ward, and the hiding aura is only the state to reveal, as in the Templar Crusader's Brand detection entry. can_detect is Unit::CanSeeOrDetect of the caster for the dummy with its default arguments. Repair (cycle 7, author C): in both final04 runs the control read 1 without a ward. The old entry read the before value right after the stealth set_aura, with no wait (gate_timing start, trigger_only_after: no cast in the control phase). With distanceCheck false, WorldObject::CanDetect (Object.cpp:1984-1992) passes checkClient and returns true for a stealthed unit the player still has at its client (Player::HaveAtClient), and the dummy had not yet left the caster's client set. The invisible variant reads 0 at once because the invisibility check has no such fallback (Object.cpp:1980-1983). The Templar predicate entry reads its hidden arm 1500 ms after the stealth aura and reads 0 (ADR 0197). The server was right and the test was wrong. Now both phases wait 2500 ms before the read. Berserking 26297 is the timed cast of both phases: a stock spell, instant, no cost (PowerType 3 with cost 0), StartRecoveryTime 0 so no GCD, TARGET_UNIT_CASTER, Effect[0] aura 193 haste only. It is a vehicle that touches no stealth, invisibility or detection state. The ward is a real setup cast in the after phase only (setup_only_after). The harness fills every power of the caster at setup (CoAGameplayTest.cpp:3038-3039) and nothing in the scenario spends mana before the ward, so its 25 mana plus 15% of base mana is there and no cast_power is needed. Control: stealth set, Berserking, 2500 ms, read 0 (the dummy has left the client set, and no ward exists). The only setup cast is the claim's own spell 674303 with setup_only_after, so the contrast is own_cast (behaviours.py:1673-1678), and the quote holds 'stealthed', so the entry counts as behaviour. behaviours.name: Potent Mixes (threat generated -30%, second equal hit with the talent)
behaviours.quote: reduces the threat generated by your spells by
behaviours.observe_source: Potent Mixes 504888 Effect[1] in the DBC is SPELL_AURA_MOD_TOTAL_THREAT 103, EffectBasePoints -31 + DieSides 1 = -30 ($s2). Since fix 27bbb789d3, AscensionWitchDoctorCompletion.cpp ApplyContracts (PotentMixes 503748 and PotentMixesGreater 504888) turns it into SPELL_AURA_MOD_THREAT with MiscValue 127 (all schools) at load, so ThreatManager::CalculateModifiedThreat multiplies every later threat of the caster by (100 - 30) / 100 = 0.7. Repair (cycle 7, author C): on the fixed build (verify-all 20261117-074923, server 41db1896c0e8) the old absolute entries read 0.828 with the talent and 1.168 without. Their with/without ratio is 0.709, which is the tooltip's 0.7. On the pair final04 (build c5caeee8740e, which predates 27bbb789d3) the talent arm read 1.1515 and 1.1519 against 1.1304 and 1.1325 for the control: a confirmed defect (recorded by D1, fixed by 27bbb789d3), on top of the absolute-target flaw. Both entries missed their absolute targets because of a threat excess with no matching health loss (D1.md: about 0.13 to 0.17 of the damage). Its source is the initial threat that Spell::HandleThreatSpells adds: m_spellInfo->SpellLevel when the spell has no spell_threat entry (Spell.cpp:5736-5737), 60 for Shadow Bolt 25307, added after PoolThreatFor with ignoreModifiers true (Spell.cpp:5765-5766). 45648 has SpellLevel 0, so that threat is 0 and HandleThreatSpells returns early (Spell.cpp:5740-5741): no excess remains. Two separate scenarios cannot be judged as one ratio, so the entry now holds both arms in one scenario on equal hits. The hit is QA Debug Holy Spell 45648: Effect[0] SCHOOL_DAMAGE 999 + DieSides 1 = 1000 fixed, SPELL_ATTR2_CANT_CRIT, CastingTimeIndex 5 = 2000 ms, StartRecoveryTime 0 (no GCD), no power cost (no mana is spent, so no energize threat follows), damage threat added unscaled as float(damage) at Unit.cpp:1412, and spell hit capped by the reference spell_hit_rating 10000. The stock tank-aura-threat-audit scenarios read its threat per damage as 1.0 +- 0.05. Holy damage on a creature is resisted only through resistance or a level difference (Unit.cpp:2653, ClassicPlusCombat.h:142-148). The dummy is level 60 like the caster, so no level term applies, and each hit deals 1000: the reading is deterministic. A resisted part would lower threat and health loss alike, so it could shift the pooled ratio only if the two hits differed. Phase 1 (control arm): one 45648 hit on a fresh dummy without the talent; the dummy's threat on the caster over the health it lost (threat_per_damage, nominally 1000/1000) is read 3000 ms after the cast. Phase 2: a second identical hit on the same dummy, read after 3000 ms; the cumulative reading is (1000 + m x 1000) / 2000. Here 504888 is learned for real between the phases (the default gate), so m = 0.7 and the reading is 1700 / 2000 = 0.85 of the control arm's reading: expected_ratio 0.85 = (1 + 0.7) / 2. The reading is deterministic, so it is judged to the rounding (G-19 scope, ADR 0135): tolerance 0.01 (0.84 to 0.86) is m from 0.68 to 0.72, the G-19 band of 2 points on -30%. A -25% talent reads 0.875 and a -20% talent 0.90, and both alert; a talent that does nothing reads 1.0, and one that also scaled the earlier threat 0.7. before_expected 0.99 sits just under the deterministic 1.0, because the ratio verdict needs the before reading at or above it with no tolerance (compare.py metric_ratio_verdict); expected 0.8415 is 0.99 x 0.85. Phase 1 is the control arm of the same scenario, and the threat_generated_control entry repeats the scenario without the talent (ratio 1.0).

behaviours.name: Disciple of Sseratus (Hexbreak global cooldown 0.5 s shorter: a Potion Toss 900 ms after it is accepted)
behaviours.quote: has a 0.5s reduced global cooldown
behaviours.observe_source: Disciple of Sseratus 300660 Effect[2]: aura 107 ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER op 21 SPELLMOD_GLOBAL_COOLDOWN, BasePoints -501 + 1 = -500 ms on class mask [1] 8388608, which Hexbreak 806240 carries (DISPEL curse, TARGET_UNIT_TARGET_ALLY, StartRecoveryCategory 133, StartRecoveryTime 1500, CastingTimeIndex 1, DmgClass 1, 25% mana); native, no class code (Spell.cpp:9203-9240, TriggerGlobalCooldown: SPELLMOD_GLOBAL_COOLDOWN at :9220, spell haste at :9223-9228, clamp to 1000..1500 at :9230-9233). Potion Toss 801661 (instant, same category 133, 18% mana, 15000 ms category cooldown reset by the scenario) is refused with SPELL_FAILED_CASTER_AURASTATE while the caster has no active Ingredient (AscensionWitchDoctorAbilities.cpp:74-75; marker 801702 is kept by Cauldron Brewer 92085, Brewing.cpp:38-45), so both phases learn 92085 (a passive, precondition fixture, the same in both phases) and cast Frog Bones 801663 (instant, StartRecoveryCategory 130, so no global cooldown against 133) for real first. Hexbreak is cast for real at the caster with Curse of Weakness 702 (Dispel curse, harness set_aura in both phases, precondition fixture; Curse of Tongues would slow casts). Cycle 6 alert (final04, both runs, build c5caeee8740e): the old entries read spell_cast_count, a cumulative counter of the whole scenario, so the after reading was the sum of both phases. Classification: incorrect test. The cast result is read instead: cast_failure of Potion Toss after the attempt, 0 accepted, 67 SPELL_FAILED_NOT_READY refused, per phase (the Necromancer stance_gcd_ready and stance_gcd_held pattern, ADR 0083). Spell queue (found in the cycle 7 review): SpellQueue.Enabled = 1 and SpellQueue.Window = 400 (src/server/apps/worldserver/worldserver.conf.dist:2322-2329), and Player::CanRequestSpellCast (PlayerUpdates.cpp:2480-2500) queues and so accepts a cast whose remaining global cooldown is at most 400 ms; the harness casts through HandleCastSpellOpcode (CoAGameplayTest.cpp:2399-2402). A refusal arm therefore keeps more than 400 ms of global cooldown remaining after the step overhead (10 to 17 ms per step, 3 steps between the Hexbreak cast and the Potion Toss cast), and an acceptance arm may be accepted by the queue or by the cleared global cooldown, both read 0. The cycle 6 reads (cumulative spell_cast_count 1 then 2 and 0 then 1) are exactly this queue: the 1200 ms attempt (300 ms left of 1500) and the 850 ms attempt (150 ms left of 1000) were queued and accepted; the base global cooldown is the 1500 ms of the DBC and no defect is suspected. Arm gcd: Frog Bones, 900 ms, Hexbreak, 900 ms, Potion Toss, cast_failure read 300 ms later. Before (talent unlearned, the control): global cooldown 1500 ms, about 560 ms left at the attempt (more than the 400 ms queue window), refused, 67. After (300660 learned between the phases, 2500 ms apart): global cooldown 1000 ms, already over or within the queue window at the attempt, accepted, 0. Cast timing checked: Frog Bones, Hexbreak and Potion Toss are instant (CastingTimeIndex 1). The gcd_clear arm tells a global cooldown refusal apart from an Ingredient, mana or cooldown refusal of the same fixture. Player reports: none on this talent.

behaviours.name: Spirit Volley (Spirit Glaive recast accepted after a Spirit Volley cut its cooldown by 3 sec)
behaviours.quote: transform your next
behaviours.observe_source: AscensionWitchDoctorAbilities.cpp:305-311 (OnSpellCast, non-triggered): id == Volley -> Reduce(player, Glaive, abs(Amount(VolleyCooldown))), ModifySpellCooldown(-3000) on every known rank of Spirit Glaive (Completion.cpp:161-174); 504584 Effect[0] BasePoints -3001 + 1 = -3000 ($/1000;504584s1 = 3). The cut depends on a completed non-triggered Spirit Volley cast and on nothing else: Amount(VolleyCooldown) (Completion.cpp:78-82) reads -3000 from the DBC of 504584 whether or not 503712 is known, so a control that only unlearns 503712 cannot refuse (cycle 7 review C1: the without arm cast the Volley and the Glaive was accepted, 0 instead of 67). The control is therefore the Volley itself: the cast is refused without the Spirit Volley ready aura 505158 (OnSpellCheckCast, Abilities.cpp:78-80: SPELL_FAILED_CASTER_AURASTATE), so the without arm, which holds no 505158, attempts the same Volley and it does not complete, no cut, and the Glaive is refused (67); the with and beyond arms hold 505158 (harness set_aura through talent_aura and talent_aura_each_arm, stacks 0 then 1 before every talent arm, read present before the priming cast; a precondition fixture, guide 3.4: the subject is the cooldown cut, the 30% roll that makes the aura has its own claim) and the Volley completes. Spirit Glaive 562719 (CastingTimeIndex 5 = 2000 ms, cooldown 20000 ms, a self-centred cone cast at the dummy) is the priming cast; 2500 ms after its submission a real Spirit Volley 504582 (ranged slot, dummy 15 yd away, CastingTimeIndex 23 = 1800 ms plus 500 ms for the ranged slot = 2300 ms, no mana cost) is cast, 500 ms after the Glaive cast ended, past the 400 ms spell queue window, and completes 4800 ms after the priming submission. The Glaive cooldown starts at its cast end, 2000 ms in, so the margin is 2500 ms instead of 500: with the cut it ends 19000 ms after the submission and the Glaive is accepted 19500 ms after it (0); without the cut it ends at 22000 ms and is refused (67, the control); 14500 ms after the submission (beyond) it is refused (67), so a cut of more than about 5 s fails. The aura is set about 1600 + 2500 ms plus step overhead before the Volley starts, inside its 6000 ms duration. Cast timing checked: Glaive 2000 ms, Volley 2300 ms, both before the attempt. Player reports: none.

behaviours.quote: transform your next

Game time (G-19 band 250 ms of 5000 ms): the stamps bracket the time from the Jinx cast to the reading, which is wait_ms 500 plus the Renew cast step plus the wait that follows it; the silence starts at the Renew cast, which comes at least wait_ms 500 after the Jinx, so its age at the reading is at least the enemy_cast_wait_ms 5100 (a wait never ends early) and at most the bracket minus 500. The window is therefore 5600 (500 + 5100) to 5750: the upper bound holds the silence's age at the reading to 5250 ms, the G-19 upper edge, so a silence of 5.4 s is still on at the reading and fails the expected 0 (the earlier 6000 admitted an age of 5500 ms). behaviours.name: Serene Idol (pushback reduction 30%, game time)
behaviours.quote: reduced spell pushback suffered from damaging attacks
behaviours.observe_source: Serene Idol 504759: the idol applies field 504760 to the caster (and grouped allies within 30 yd) every second (AscensionWitchDoctorSummons.cpp:515-520); 504760 Effect[2] SPELL_AURA_REDUCE_PUSHBACK, BasePoints 29 + 1 = 30 ($504760s3). Stock pushback (Spell::Delayed, Spell.cpp:8066-8090) delays the cast by 500 ms per damaging hit, less the REDUCE_PUSHBACK percent. One scenario, three Malefic Wrath 807037 casts (CastingTimeIndex 5 = 2000 ms, 11% mana, cast_power 2000 before each) at the dummy: unhit; hit once by the passive striker's Light of the Naaru 41394 (Holy) 1000 ms into the cast; and the same after a real cast of Serene Idol 504759 (instant, reducer_wait_ms 1600 past its GCD of 1000 ms, so the field has landed: the idol's first update is at once). The windows are the Necromancer Icebound Champion windows moved to a 2000 ms cast: the Icebound unhit window [2440, 2480] sits 40 ms before its 2500 ms nominal end, the hit window 490 ms later and the 50% reduced window 240 ms after the unhit one, so for 2000 ms the unhit window is [1940, 1980], the hit window [2430, 2470] and the 30% reduced window (350 ms instead of 500, 340 ms after the unhit centre) [2280, 2320]. The judge brackets the reduction from the polled cast ends, not from the windows; the windows only choose which polls are read, so a wrong window gives unmeasured, never ok. repeats 4 as the Icebound entry. Control: the unhit and hit casts without the idol. behaviours.quote: have 1 poison and disease effect removed from them
behaviours.observe_source: AscensionWitchDoctorSummons.cpp:309-310 (the Cleansing Idol 50217 sets _timer 3000 when it is summoned) and :509-513 (each 3000 ms it casts Cleansing Idol 505348 on every ally Allies(player, me, 30 yd) returns, the caster included); Completion.cpp:507-515 retargets 505348 to TARGET_UNIT_TARGET_ALLY. 505348 Effect[0] SPELL_EFFECT_DISPEL EffectMiscValue 3 (DISPEL_DISEASE) and Effect[1] SPELL_EFFECT_DISPEL EffectMiscValue 4 (DISPEL_POISON), EffectBasePoints 0 + DieSides 1 = one effect per type per pulse. The glaive lands about 166 ms after the cast (Speed 30, the dummy 3 yd away, floored to 5 yd: floor(5 / 30 x 1000) = 166, Spell.cpp:2474-2476) and ticks at 1166, 2166, 3166, 4166 and 5166 ms: the heals of 501134 on the caster are counted twice, stamped in game time, 4 at 4916 ms after the cast (window 4866 to 4966 ms, wait 4907 ms plus the 9 ms of the stamp step) and 5 at 5416 ms (window 5366 to 5466 ms). The two stamps are the fifth tick's time at a period 5% short (166 + 5 x 950 = 4916 ms) and at a period 5% long (166 + 5 x 1050 = 5416 ms): a period of 950 ms or less would have brought the fifth tick by the first stamp and reads 5 there, a period of 1050 ms or more brings it no earlier than the second stamp and reads 4 there, and a first tick at the apply (the reported "DoT starting at once") reads 5 at the first stamp. The accepted periods are 950 to 1050 ms, centred on the clause's 1 sec once the flight time is in the stamps. Judged as a bracket in game time (the G-19 band of 5% of the period): the count read at the first stamp must still be short of the pulse that a period 5% too short would have brought, the count read at the second stamp must include the pulse that a period 5% too long would still be missing; a count of whole heals read at one time accepts about +-20% of the period, which the two stamps avoid. Control: the uncast before phase reads 0. The duration half of the clause is read by scales_lasts_control (the curse still stands at 5900 ms and is gone 400 ms later, its end at about 6166 ms). Its AI pulses every 1000 ms from the first update (_timer starts at 1, Summons.cpp:246 and :457-462) and casts the field 506820 on every valid enemy that Nearby(me, 10.0f) returns (Summons.cpp:530-539; Field() at :378-383 passes the owner as original caster, so the aura's caster is the Witch Doctor; the aura is set to 2200 ms and refreshed every pulse). 506820 is Effect[0] aura 290 (crit chance -100) with EffectRadiusIndex 18 = 15 yd ($506820a1); its native area is replaced by one target (AscensionWitchDoctorCompletion.cpp:518-527), so the script search is the only selector. Nearby() is AnyUnitInObjectRangeCheck, WorldObject::IsWithinDistInMap with both object sizes (GridNotifiers.h:1061-1075, Object.cpp:1256-1263; G-29 mechanism 3): an enemy is fielded while its centre lies within 10 + 1.0 (effigy 50121, display 427391 CombatReach 1.0, DisplayScale 1, world DB) + 1.275 = 12.275 yd of the effigy today, and within 15 + 2.275 = 17.275 yd once the search uses the 506820 radius. Layout (the kind puts the primary 0.5 yd in front of the caster and the two dummies radius + 1.275 + center_reach 1.0 -/+ 2.5 yd beyond it, on the caster's +x line at the creation point -8949.95, -132.493, o 0 of race 1 class 13): inside 14.775 yd and outside 19.775 yd from the primary. Measured from the effigy (about -0.04, +1.50 yd from the caster) the inside dummy stands about 15.4 yd away, 3.1 yd beyond today's 12.275 yd edge and 1.9 yd inside the tooltip edge; the outside dummy about 20.3 yd, 3.0 yd beyond the tooltip edge. The primary (about 1.6 yd from the effigy) is fielded in every build. The 2.5 yd margin (not 0.5 yd, G-29) is forced by the grid: Cell::VisitObjects visits the cells of the square x +- radius without the object sizes (CellImpl.h:42-55 and :165-177), cell edges lie at x = 66.667 k, the next one at -8933.33, 16.6 yd ahead of the caster; a 0.5 yd inside dummy would stand at -8933.1, past that edge, and a 15 yd search from the effigy (to -8935.0) would never visit its cell. The outside dummy lies in the next cell: below a search radius of about 16.7 yd that cell is not visited, and from 16.7 to 18 yd the dummy (about 20.3 yd from the effigy) is beyond the distance edge, so it reads 0 for any fix radius below about 18 yd; a fix using 18 yd or more would field it and alert. G-29 requires a 0.5 yd bracket measured centre to centre from the server-read reach; this layout brackets 2.5 yd from the primary, so a pass would bound the radius only to about 12.2 to 17.2 yd for the stated 15 yd. The label 706542 behaviour_metric_delta effigy_radius_edge is therefore not listed in any ledger claim; it stays in the class file to reproduce lead R3-e1 on the pre-fix build and to show the fix lands, until the mentor rules on the margin or the tool reads a summoned centre (tool note T-c8-2). AscensionWitchDoctorAuras.cpp:409-417 (aura script Remove): when the debuff ends by expiry and Godslayer 802714 is on the caster, Cast(player, target, 806616) hits the afflicted enemy (:413), then Nearby(GetTarget(), 10.0f) casts 806616 on every other valid enemy (:414-416). The tooltip says "to the enemy and all enemies within $806616a1 yds" (806616 EffectRadiusIndex 14 = 8 yd; M-49, G-1). Nearby() is WorldObject::IsWithinDistInMap with both object sizes (GridNotifiers.h:1061-1075, Object.cpp:1256-1263; G-29 mechanism 3), so a dummy (combat reach 1.275, both read in the Templar 1161 edge run) is splashed while its centre lies within 10 + 2.55 = 12.55 yd of the afflicted dummy today and within 8 + 2.55 = 10.55 yd under the tooltip. Layout: the splash dummy area1 stands 1.0 yd from the caster's start and the afflicted dummy further out on the +x line; relocate_before_trigger moves the caster 4 yd along +x before each Glaive (to 4 yd in the before phase, 8 yd in the after phase), so area1 stands 3 and 7 yd behind the caster: outside the cone (Unit::isInFront, and beyond the 2 yd boundary radius of WorldObjectSpellConeTargetCheck, Spell.cpp:9500-9503, Unit.cpp:954-962) and well inside the 30 yd range plus both reaches that the explosion's own CheckRange applies to a triggered cast (Spell.cpp:6222-6224, 7329-7345). So area1 never carries a debuff of its own and can only be hit by the splash. No unit stands in a grid cell the 10 or 8 yd search would not visit (the cell edge is at x = -8933.33; all units lie between -8949 and -8937). The before phase (802714 not known) reads 0 whatever the geometry (no explosion). The read is the count of 806616 hits of the caster on area1, 8500 ms after the cast start (the debuff ends about 7000 ms after it, as in godslayer_hit). The hit on the afflicted dummy itself is godslayer_hit. Player reports: none. The live logs of 2026-08 show no splash (R3-e3, M-49), recorded as an observation; the tooltip governs. This arm: the afflicted dummy at 11.05 yd, area1 10.05 yd from it, 0.5 yd inside the tooltip edge (10.55) and inside today's 12.55: one 806616 hit on area1 in every build (expected 1). It is the control of godslayer_splash_beyond: the splash exists and reaches a dummy behind the caster, so a 0 there is the radius and not a missing explosion. Geometry assumption (fix round): metric_delta reads no reach, height or distance in this run. The 0.5 yd brackets rest on the dummy reach of 1.275 read in the Templar 1161 edge run (same creature 36, display 367) and on flat ground at the creation point: the engine test is 3D, so a height difference above about 3.2 yd between area1 and the afflicted dummy would move area1 beyond 10.55 yd and falsely fail the inside arm (the beyond arm can only read lower, and still reproduces today unless the difference exceeds about 5.9 yd). Tool note T-c8-4 asks for a metric_delta area_dummies geometry readback.

behaviours.name: Spirit Idol (allies regenerate 4% maximum mana every 3 sec)
behaviours.quote: regenerate $805282s1% maximum mana every $500958t2 sec.
behaviours.observe_source: AscensionWitchDoctorSummons.cpp:246 (_timer starts at 1), :457-462 and :503-507: the Spirit Idol AI (creature 50106) runs its first update at once, casts Spirit Idol energize 805282 (SpiritManaTick) on every ally Allies(player, me, 30 yd) returns (the caster counts as its own ally, Friendly(): Completion.cpp:57-62) and sets _timer to 3000 ms; $500958t2 = 3000 (Spirit Idol 500958 Effect[1] EffectAmplitude 3000). 805282 Effect[0] is SPELL_EFFECT_ENERGIZE_PCT (BasePoints 3 + 1 = 4, $805282s1; mana), whose gain is CalculatePct(maxPower, 4) (SpellEffects.cpp:3036-3045): with the reference caster's 2567 maximum mana 102 mana per pulse. The energize is cast with m_caster the idol creature, so the energize log names the creature and spell_energize_* (player caster only) reads nothing; the caster's mana itself is read instead (metric power, regeneration off, mana set to 1000 before the cast, below the 2567 maximum so no pulse is capped). Spirit Idol 500961 is instant and free (ManaCost 0, ManaCostPercentage 0, RecoveryTime 180000 reset by the scenario). The mana is read twice, stamped in game time: 1204 (two pulses, at about 0 and 3000 ms) at about 5750 ms (window 5700 to 5800) and 1306 (three pulses, the third at about 6000 ms) at about 6350 ms (window 6300 to 6400). A period 5% short (2850 ms) would have brought the third pulse by 5700 ms and reads 1306 at the first stamp, a period 5% long (3150 ms) brings it after 6300 ms and reads 1204 at the second stamp, a missing pulse reads 1102 and 1204, a doubled cadence far more; the amount of 4% is the 102 per pulse. The tolerance of 1 absorbs the rounding of a 4% of a differently rounded maximum. Control: the uncast before phase reads the same 1000 (phase_power_in_uncast_before) with regeneration off, so only the Idol raises it. Clause 396 "Allies within $500958A1 yds regenerate $805282s1% maximum mana every $500958t2 sec."; the radius is data (effect_radius 500958e0 #1). Player reports: none (the idol family report #11995 runs through the same Summon path). Cast timing checked: instant.

Its AI pulses from the first update and every 1000 ms (_timer starts at 1, Summons.cpp:246 and :457-462) and, for every valid enemy that Nearby(me, 10.0f) returns (Summons.cpp:530-540), applies Shadow Effigy 504761 through Field() (owner as original caster, aura 2200 ms renewed each pulse; the same scan as Cursed Effigy 706542, radius_edge effigy_radius_edge of author T). 504761 Effect[0] has EffectRadiusIndex 10 = 30 yd ($504761a1); its native area is replaced by the script scan (Completion.cpp:518-532), so the scan is the only selector. Nearby() is AnyUnitInObjectRangeCheck, WorldObject::IsWithinDistInMap with both object sizes (GridNotifiers.h:1061-1075, Object.cpp:1256-1263; G-29 mechanism 3): an enemy is affected while its centre lies within 10 + 1.0 (effigy) + 1.275 (dummy entry 36) = 12.275 yd of the effigy today and within 30 + 2.275 = 32.275 yd under the tooltip. Layout (the kind puts the primary 0.5 yd in front of the caster and the two dummies on the caster's +x line at 32.775 - 0.9 = 31.875 yd and 32.775 + 0.9 = 33.675 yd from the caster): measured from the effigy (0.075 yd farther than from the caster for dummies this far out, from its offset (-0.04, +1.5)) the inside dummy stands about 31.95 yd away, 0.33 yd inside the tooltip edge, and the outside dummy about 33.75 yd, 1.48 yd beyond it: a server whose effective radius (centre to centre less both sizes) lies between about 29.7 and 31.5 yd passes, against the stated 30 yd and its G-19 band of 5% = 1.5 yd. The margin is 0.9 yd, not 0.5 yd (G-29): the 0.5 yd primary distance and the effigy skew put every dummy 0.575 yd farther from the effigy than the judge measures from the primary, so a 0.5 yd inside dummy would stand outside the true edge. The grid cannot hide either dummy under a fix: a 30 yd search from the effigy reaches caster-relative x = 29.96, past the cell edge 16.6 yd ahead of the caster (cell edges at 66.667 k, CellImpl.h:42-55), so the next cell, which holds both dummies, is visited; both dummies and the effigy lie in the same y cell (edge 0.84 yd below the caster, search +-30 yd). The judge measures from the primary and adds the primary's read reach (1.275) as the centre's (0.275 yd above the effigy's 1.0); its distances stay inside the margin. Control arm: the effigy cast before 505339 is learned is refused, no 504761 on any dummy. Treatment: one cast, the aura 504761 read 3100 ms later (1600 ms wait after the instant cast plus settle_ms 1500). Expected on the current code: the primary affected, the inside dummy not (alert, lead L-B9-2: the 10.0f scan against the tooltip's 30 yd); after a fix to the 504761 radius the inside dummy is affected and the outside one not. Clause 400 "Enemies within $504761a1 yds". The casting-speed amount and the movement slow are read by effigy_cast_slow and effigy_move_slow. Player reports: none (Hexing Effigy #4457 is the same family and the same Summon path). Cast timing checked: instant. Integrator, cycle 8 (M-55): a confirmed defect, not fixed in this pair: the effigy searches 10 yd (Summons.cpp:531) against the tooltip $504761a1 = 30 yd. A trial build that searched Radius(ShadowField) still left a dummy 29.78 yd from the primary unhit; Shadow Effigy 504761 has RangeIndex 1 (self only), unlike Cursed Effigy 506820, so the field cast is the likely second block (unproven). Reproduction only, as 706542 effigy_radius_edge: the judge measures from the primary dummy and the code from the effigy, so the margin is 2.5 yd and the label is out of the radius claim until the radius is centred on the summon (tool note T-c8-2).

behaviours.name: Potion Boss (the Potion Toss heal is 20% stronger)
behaviours.quote: Increases the effectiveness of
behaviours.observe_source: Potion Boss 561072 (passive) Effect[0] aura 108 SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER, EffectMiscValue 8 (SPELLMOD_ALL_EFFECTS), EffectBasePoints 19 + 1 = 20 ($s1), EffectSpellClassMask word 1 bit 2048 and word 2 bit 4096 (the family flags of Potion Toss 801661, SpellFamilyFlags[1] 526336, and of the tossed Ingredient potions: Frog Bones 802971 and Jungle Shrooms 802973 carry SpellFamilyFlags[2] 4096); SpellInfo::CalcValue applies the all-effects modifier of the caster. 92085 is learned at the start (a precondition fixture: the Has Ingredient Marker 801702 Potion Toss needs, Brewing.cpp:38-45) and Ingredient: Frog Bones 801663 is cast first (setup, instant, 5% mana). Potion Boss is learned between the phases (a real learn). Potion Toss itself is Effect[0] SPELL_EFFECT_HEAL (BasePoints 107, DieSides 4, 1.386 per level, TARGET_UNIT_TARGET_ALLY), cast here at the caster; the harness sums the raw heal amounts of 801661 on the caster (spell_heal_total, cumulative over the two phases), so the ratio after / before is (X + X') / X. Potion Toss also carries a spirit coefficient of 0.10 (AscensionWitchDoctorCoefficients.h:128; Spirit 109 gives +10.9). The Spirit bonus is scaled by the modifier too: ModifySpellEffectBaseValue adds Spirit x 0.10 to the base value inside SpellEffectInfo::CalcValue (SpellInfo.cpp:523) and ApplyEffectModifiers (SPELLMOD_ALL_EFFECTS, Unit.cpp:12938) then runs on the sum (SpellInfo.cpp:531), so the whole heal gains 20%. With the base B of 116 to 119 (107 + the level part 8 + the die 1 to 4) and the Spirit term 10.9, the first heal X = int(B + 10.9) reads 126 to 129 and the boosted one X' = int(1.2 (B' + 10.9)) reads 152 to 155, so the ratio (X + X') / X lies between 281/129 = 2.178 and 281/126 = 2.230 (centre 2.2); 2.0 is a heal without the modifier. The tolerance 0.05 (2.15 to 2.25) holds the whole range, including the corner X = 126 with X' = 155, and excludes 2.0.
