behaviours.observe_source: Growing Malice 706551 (passive, aura script aura_ascension_witch_doctor_event): AscensionWitchDoctorEvents.cpp:85-87 (Check) lets a periodic damage tick of a Hex (IsHex) through, :220-234 (Proc) casts the debuff 582257 on the target (StackAmount 10 = $582257u, DurationIndex 5, Effect[0] aura 271 MOD_DAMAGE_FROM_CASTER 2 + 1 = 3% = $582257s1) and rescales the owned Hex's tick amount by (100 + 3 x new stacks) / (100 + 3 x old stacks); Auras.cpp:399-400 removes the debuff with the Hex. Hex of Malice 504608: instant, 20% base mana, DurationIndex 106 = 24000 ms, Effect[0] periodic damage every 3000 ms, tick 159.06 at level 60 (the Hex of Malice tick entry 504608 'tick'). Tick k (k = 0 to 7) deals 159.06 x (1 + 0.03 k) because the Proc rescales the Hex's amount by (100 + 3 s') / (100 + 3 s): the eight ticks sum to 159.06 x (8 + 0.03 x 28) = 1406.1, against 1272.5 without the talent (the control, 134 below, outside 5% = 70) and against about 1559 (outside 70 above, see the next sentences): the sum of the periodic non-critical damage of 504608 on the dummy is read 24500 ms after the cast, with the beeg spellpen aura 823764 on the caster (no partial resists, the Hex tick entry's shape) and no passive 574358, so no tick crits. The ticks are the damage claim ('increases the damage of the next tick by $582257s1%'); the cap of 10 stacks is not reachable inside one 24000 ms Hex (eight ticks) and its data label stays. Expected from the code as it stands: about 1559, not 1406. The debuff 582257 Effect[0] is aura 271 (SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_FROM_CASTER, BasePoints 2 + 1 = 3%) whose EffectSpellClassMask word 1 is 33554432, the Hex flag (IsHex, Completion.h:371-374), so Unit::SpellDamageBonusTaken also scales every tick of the Hex by 3% per stack on top of the Proc rescale of the Hex amount (AscensionWitchDoctorEvents.cpp:232-233): tick k deals 159.06 x (1 + 0.03 k) x (1 + 0.03 k), 159.06 x 9.806 = 1559.7 over the eight ticks. The tooltip says each tick deals 3% more than the last, so 1406 governs (G-1) and an alert reading about 1559 is a correct candidate defect lead (a double count of the stack bonus), reported to the owner and never fixed by this entry. Control: the uncast before phase reads 0. Clause 251. Cast timing checked: instant, ticks 3000 ms apart to 24000 ms. Player reports: none of the open reports of cycles 5 and 6 names this spell.

behaviours.name: Potion Boss (the Frog Bones potion shield is 20% stronger: 388 then 465)
behaviours.quote: Increases the effectiveness of
behaviours.observe_source: Potion Boss 561072 (passive) Effect[0] aura 108 SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER, EffectMiscValue 8 (SPELLMOD_ALL_EFFECTS), EffectBasePoints 19 + 1 = 20 ($s1), EffectSpellClassMask word 1 bit 2048 and word 2 bit 4096 (the family flags of Potion Toss 801661, SpellFamilyFlags[1] 526336, and of the tossed Ingredient potions: Frog Bones 802971 and Jungle Shrooms 802973 carry SpellFamilyFlags[2] 4096); SpellInfo::CalcValue applies the all-effects modifier of the caster. 92085 is learned at the start (a precondition fixture: the Has Ingredient Marker 801702 Potion Toss needs, Brewing.cpp:38-45) and Ingredient: Frog Bones 801663 is cast first (setup, instant, 5% mana). Potion Boss is learned between the phases (a real learn). Potion: Frog Bones 802971 is SPELL_AURA_SCHOOL_ABSORB with the shield ${$802971m1+$SPI*.35+$BH*.8} of the Frog Bones Ingredient tooltip 801663: EffectBasePoints 99 + 1 + 5.0 per level above BaseLevel 10 = 350 at level 60, plus 0.35 x Spirit 109 = 38.15 added to the base value by witch_doctor_scaling (AscensionWitchDoctorCompletion.cpp:644-659, ModifySpellEffectBaseValue; AscensionWitchDoctorCoefficients.h:140, {802971, 0, 0.8 healing, 0.35 spirit}), so 388.15 (the 567736 `bones_potion` read, 388 since the cycle 8 R repair). The shield is read as damage absorbed: 500 ms after each cast a level 60 striker casts Light of the Naaru 41394 six times at the caster held at 20000 health, and the absorbed amounts of those hits are summed from the logs (spell_absorb_total, cumulative over the two phases). SpellEffectInfo::CalcValue (SpellInfo.cpp:518-531) runs the scaling hook on the float value first and then Unit::ApplyEffectModifiers with the caster's SPELLMOD_ALL_EFFECTS, so the 20% applies to the whole shield, Spirit part included, as the tooltip "increases the effectiveness of ... your tossed Ingredients by $s1%" names the whole potion. Before phase (Potion Boss unknown, the control): 388 (int32 of 388.15). After phase: the same cast adds int32(388.15 x 1.2 = 465.78) = 465, so the cumulative reads 853 and the gain 465 within 2; a missing modifier would add 388, and a modifier on the 350 base alone would add 458. Repair (author S, cycle 8): the old expectation 420 left out the Spirit term the tooltip states; the sweep 20261121-011354 on the fix build 6cdbd8c441 (worldserver 2ef5992e), judged in C:/cw/s8cmp read 388 before and 853 after, a gain of 465. Cast timing checked: Frog Bones and Potion Toss are instant, the Potion Toss 15000 ms category is reset by the scenario. Player reports: none open on this spell in cycle5/PLAN.md or cycle6/PLAN.md.

behaviours.name: Jungle Booms (the Jungle Shrooms Cauldron heals for 100% more)
behaviours.quote: now heal for $s1% more,
behaviours.observe_source: Jungle Booms 705859 (passive) Effect[0] aura 108 ADD_PCT_MODIFIER BasePoints 99 + 1 = 100 ($s1), EffectSpellClassMask word 2 bit 2048, the SpellFamilyFlags[2] of Ingredient: Jungle Shrooms 802703 (SpellFamilyFlags[2] 2176, the field spell the Shrooms aura 801660 casts every 6000 ms, Effect[0] SPELL_EFFECT_HEAL BasePoints 90, DieSides 2, TARGET_UNIT_CASTER_AREA_RAID, EffectRadiusIndex 10 = 30 yd, MaxAffectedTargets 8); the first pulse comes 6000 ms after the apply (aura 801660 has EffectAmplitude 6000 and no START_PERIODIC_AT_APPLY), so a real Ingredient: Jungle Shrooms 801660 (instant, 5% mana) cast at the caster heals the caster (a raid member of itself) once by 6500 ms. The harness sums the raw heal amounts of 802703 on the caster (spell_heal_total, cumulative over the two phases), the Shrooms aura removed at the start of each phase (phase_aura stacks 0) so each phase makes one first pulse, and Reg's Test Aura 984954 (Effect[1] aura 57 spell crit -1000, a precondition fixture, the Beam 501117 heal precedent) set on the caster in both phases: Shrooms 802703 is DmgClass 1 (Nature, magic), its crit chance is the spell crit (the reference Nature spell crit reads 3.387%, `705877 spell_crit_chance` in final05), and one crit among the three rolls would move the ratio out of 3.0 +- 0.05 (about 6.7% of runs would alert falsely). The ratio after / before is (X + X') / X with X' = 2 X, so 3.0 for +100% and 2.0 without it, within 0.05 (the die of 2 spreads the two rolls by about 1%). The Shrooms tooltip 801660 states the pulse as ${$802703m1*$<scalingbp>+$BH*.2}: the server applies the level factor in ascension_scaling_base (AscensionScalingBase.cpp:13-16 and :36-53, ScalingBase(60) = 0.98744, 802703 effect 0 in ScalingBaseSpells), so a pulse is int32(91..92 x 0.98744) = 89 or 90 and with the talent 179 to 181 (the sweep read 89, then 180 more). before_expected 89 is the floor of the first pulse and expected 267 the floor of the sum; the ratio stays inside 2.97 to 3.03 for every die pair, inside 3.0 +- 0.05. Repair (author S, cycle 8): the old floor 90 left out $<scalingbp>; the sweep 20261121-011354 on the fix build 6cdbd8c441 (worldserver 2ef5992e), judged in C:/cw/s8cmp read 89 before and 269 after, ratio 3.0225. The Modifier path is stock (SpellInfo::CalcValue); the class code only turns the second effect of 705859 into SPELL_AURA_MOD_MAX_AFFECTED_TARGETS (AscensionWitchDoctorCompletion.cpp:396-402), which does not touch the amount. Control: the before phase (705859 unknown). Cast timing checked: Shrooms instant, pulse at 6000 ms, read 6500 ms after the cast. Player reports: none open on this spell in cycle5/PLAN.md or cycle6/PLAN.md.

behaviours.name: Spiritual Traditions (pushback reduction 70%, game time)
behaviours.quote: reduces your spell pushback suffered from damaging attacks by $s1%.
behaviours.observe_source: Spiritual Traditions 705911 (passive) Effect[0] aura 149 SPELL_AURA_REDUCE_PUSHBACK, EffectMiscValue 4, BasePoints 69 + 1 = 70 ($s1); stock pushback (Spell::Delayed, Spell.cpp:8066-8090) delays the cast by 500 ms per damaging hit less the REDUCE_PUSHBACK percent of the caster; no file under src/server/coa names 705911. The Lich Essence 802988 / Serene Idol 504759 game-time design (ADR 0543): four Malefic Wrath 807037 casts (CastingTimeIndex 5 = 2000 ms, 11% mana, cast_power 2000) at the dummy in one scenario: unhit and hit once by the passive striker's Light of the Naaru 41394 1000 ms into the cast without the talent, then the talent learned (reducer_learn, 500 ms later) and the hit and the unhit cast again. Windows in the kind's order (PUSHBACK_LEARNED_PHASES = unhit, hit, reduced_unhit, reduced, kinds/pushback_reduction.py:21, as the Lich Essence 802988 entry lists them): unhit [1940, 1980], hit [2430, 2470] (500 ms of pushback), reduced unhit [1940, 1980], reduced hit [2090, 2130] (500 x 0.30 = 150 ms later); a window gives the first poll, and its 41 polls cover about 400 ms of game time. Repair (author S, cycle 8): the old list gave the reduced hit window third and the reduced unhit window fourth, so the reduced unhit polls began at 2099 ms, after that cast had ended ("reduced_unhit 1: the polls do not hold both the cast and its end", sweep 20261121-011354 on the fix build 6cdbd8c441 (worldserver 2ef5992e), judged in C:/cw/s8cmp). The same sweep ends the casts at about 2004 ms (unhit), 2499 ms (hit) and 2151 ms (reduced hit, three of four repeats; the fourth strike did not land and the judge leaves that repeat out): 1 - (2151 - 2004) / (2499 - 2004) = 70.3%, against 70 +- 3.5; the judge brackets the reduction 1 - (reduced hit end - reduced unhit end) / (hit end - unhit end) from the polled cast ends and judges it against 70 in the G-19 band (5% of 70 = 3.5 points), a wrong window gives unmeasured, never ok. Control: the unhit and hit casts before the learn (a hit costs the full 500 ms). The mana regeneration half of the tooltip has no route (see the report). Cast timing checked: Wrath 2000 ms, Hit at 1000 ms. Player reports: none open on this spell in cycle5/PLAN.md or cycle6/PLAN.md.

The Ingredient is a real cast before the Potion Toss (setup, 1700 ms settle, learned with the Cauldron Brewer 92085); the aura is read on the caster 14500 ms after the Potion Toss and 800 ms later, the end inside the G-19 band (5% of 15000 ms = 750 ms) on both sides, both reads stamped in game time.
